name: Library
description: Library is where everything you generate in any studio is saved automatically, plus your uploaded files. You can filter, search, preview, download, copy prompts, save to Content, delete, or send an upload to a studio.
shortDescription: Everything you generated and uploaded, in one place.
fullDescription: Library (route #/library) is headed "Library" with the line "Everything you have generated and uploaded, in one place". The empty state says "Everything you create in any studio is saved here automatically". It shows a grid of your images, videos and audio clips with filter buttons (All, Images, Videos, Audio, Uploads) that show counts such as "Images · 4", a sort menu (Newest first, Oldest first) and a search box ("Search by prompt or model..."). History is loaded from cloud storage (Supabase) and from this browser, merged without duplicates; when a MuAPI key is saved, MuAPI's own generation history is also folded in on a best-effort basis. The Uploads view is a separate permanent Asset Library of files you uploaded in studios. The old "pexels-media" page now redirects to Library.
bestFor: Finding, previewing, downloading and reusing anything you have made or uploaded.
whenToUse: You generated something and want to find or download it.
You want to copy the prompt of a past result.
You want to reuse an uploaded file in another studio without uploading again.
You want to keep a favourite by saving it to Content.
whenToUseAnother: To keep a curated set of favourites, uploads, PDFs and stock media, use Content (#/content-library).
To edit video on a timeline, use Timeline Editor (#/timeline).
To make new things, open a studio from Apps (#/apps).
keyFeatures: Filters: All, Images, Videos, Audio, Uploads (with counts).
Search by prompt or model (also matches template name).
Hover quick actions: Download, Copy prompt, Save, Delete.
Click an image or video to open a detail view with a Download button.
Uploads view with "Use in studio" and Delete.
Audio clips play inline with a player.

featureExplanations.explanation: Buttons labelled All, Images, Videos, Audio and Uploads. The first four show a count after loading, for example "Videos · 3". Uploads shows your permanent uploaded files instead of generations.
Type in "Search by prompt or model..." to match the prompt text, model name or template name. The sort menu offers "Newest first" and "Oldest first".
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Find an item by what you typed or which model made it.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Search matches text metadata only, not image content.

featureExplanations.explanation: Hover over an item to see four small buttons at the top left: Download, Copy prompt (only if the item has a prompt; shows "Prompt copied"), Save (copies it to Content; shows "Saved to Content") and Delete (asks "Delete this generation? This cannot be undone.").
featureExplanations.restrictions: Delete removes it from your Library history; MuAPI history will not bring it back.

featureExplanations.explanation: Click an image or video to open a detail view showing the prompt, model and date with a Download action. Audio items are played with the inline player instead.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Look closely, read the prompt, download.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Audio items do not open the detail view.

featureExplanations.explanation: The Uploads filter lists files you uploaded in a studio (stored permanently). Hover for "Use in studio" and "Delete". Use in studio opens a chooser listing Image Studio, Edit Studio, Upscale Suite, Effects Studio, Cinema Studio, Storyboard Studio, Video Tools and Audio Studio, plus Cancel. If the chosen studio is already open it receives the file; otherwise the file is queued and the studio opens.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Reuse a reference image or video without re-uploading.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Only those eight studios appear in the chooser.

howToUse: 1. Open Library from the left side menu (My Work group). 2. Pick a filter: All, Images, Videos, Audio or Uploads. 3. Optionally sort or search. 4. Hover an item and use Download, Copy prompt, Save or Delete, or click it to preview. 5. In Uploads, hover a file and press "Use in studio" and pick a studio.
howToSteps: Open Library from the left side menu.
Choose All, Images, Videos, Audio or Uploads.
Search or change the sort order if needed.
Hover an item for Download, Copy prompt, Save, Delete; or click it to preview.
In Uploads choose "Use in studio" to reuse a file.
gettingStarted: Generate something in any studio; it appears in Library automatically.
Use Save on favourites so they also show in Content.

inputDetails.name: Search by prompt or model...
inputDetails.description: Filters visible items by prompt, model or template text.

outputs: Downloaded files, copied prompts, items saved to Content, assets sent to a studio.
limitations: The Uploads view needs a working asset service and key context; if it cannot load, it shows an empty list.
Audio items cannot be opened in the detail view.

limitationDetails.impact: You cannot trim or restyle inside Library.
limitationDetails.workaround: Send an upload to a studio with Use in studio, or open the Timeline Editor.

troubleshooting: No generations yet: nothing has been generated in this browser/account; create something in a studio first.
Nothing matches this filter: clear the search or choose All.
An item is missing: it may have been deleted, or generated in another browser before it was synced; check the cloud/MuAPI history by saving your MuAPI key.
Uploads shows "No uploaded assets yet": upload a file inside a studio first.
Download opens a new tab instead of saving: right-click the file and choose Save.

troubleshootingSteps.issue: My latest generation is not in Library
steps: Wait a few seconds and reopen Library.
Confirm your MuAPI key is saved in Settings.

commonProblems.whyItHappens: Delete asks once, then removes it from your Library history.
commonProblems.howToFix: It cannot be undone from Library; regenerate it using the prompt if you copied it.

exampleWorkflows.title: Reuse an upload
steps: Hover a file and press Use in studio.

useCases.title: Find a past prompt
useCases.description: Search and copy the prompt of an earlier result.
steps: Search by a word you remember.
Hover the item and press Copy prompt.
useCases.expectedOutput: The prompt copied to your clipboard.

faqs.question: Where do my generated files go?
faqs.answer: Everything you create in any studio is saved to Library automatically. Open Library from the left side menu.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Library and Content?
faqs.answer: Library is the automatic history of everything generated or uploaded. Content is what you chose to keep: items you Saved, uploads, PDFs and stock media. Removing something from Content leaves it in Library.

faqs.question: How do I download a result?
faqs.answer: Hover it and press Download, or click it and use Download in the detail view.

faqs.question: How do I delete a result?
faqs.answer: Hover it, press Delete and confirm "Delete this generation? This cannot be undone."

faqs.question: Can I reuse an uploaded file in another studio?
faqs.answer: Yes. Library > Uploads > Use in studio, then pick Image Studio, Edit Studio, Upscale Suite, Effects Studio, Cinema Studio, Storyboard Studio, Video Tools or Audio Studio.

glossary.Generation: An image, video or audio clip created in a studio.
glossary.Uploads: Files you uploaded in a studio, kept permanently in the Asset Library.
glossary.Use in studio: Hands an upload to a studio so you do not upload it again.

tips: Search by model name to compare results from the same model.
Use Copy prompt to rebuild a good result.
Save the best results to Content.
bestPractices: Download important results soon after generating.
Save keepers to Content so you can find them quickly.

relatedStudioGuidance.whenToMove: You want your favourites in one place.
relatedStudioGuidance.why: Save in Library copies an item to Content.
Use in studio can send an upload to Upscale Suite.

notConfirmed: How long generated-file links stay valid is not stated in the code; only Uploads are described as permanent storage.
Storage limits and whether deleting also removes the file from cloud storage are not documented.
Cloud sync depends on the Supabase setup of the deployment.
